# ONLYOFFICE DocSpace API

> The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace HTTP API. Every page of the reference is available as Markdown at its own address, with `.md` appended.

## Full references

One document per service, each carrying every endpoint of that service and the models it uses.

- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace Backup API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/backup.md)
- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace Files API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/files.md)
- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace AI API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/newai.md)
- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace OAuth 2.0 API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/oauth.md)
- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace People API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/people.md)
- [ONLYOFFICE DocSpace Portal API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/api-backend/api.md)
